The '''Mauk system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Kastolar sector/Legends|Kastolar sector]] in the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mauk]].
